jobs.name: Daily PR review digest
jobs.prompt: Use the review-digest skill to prepare today's persisted PR review digest for the previous 24 hours. Keep GitHub-verified reviews separate from private proposals that exhausted both reminders. Include product context from Linear and important review insights. If neither group has entries, send a short no-reviews-or-pending-decisions message.

jobs.name: Private PR review reminders
jobs.prompt: Use the review-reminder skill to deliver due private PR review reminders to their persisted Slack DM threads. The skill must acknowledge every send and return exactly NO_REPLY.
